# Dines Orthopedics

> > Leading orthopedic practice specializing in sports medicine and minimally invasive surgery, serving professional athletes and patients across New York.

Founded by David Dines and Joshua Dines, this practice operates through Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS) locations in Manhattan, Upper East Side, and Long Island. The team serves as official orthopedic surgeons for the NY Mets, NY Rangers, and ATP World Tennis Tour, offering advanced treatments including arthroscopic surgery, PRP therapy, and robotic-assisted knee replacement.
